queue.t: New on the map: West Bengal Postal Circle
queue.m: The India Post circle covering West Bengal, Sikkim and the Andaman & Nicobar Islands, which handles postal mail and parcels, including international shipments such as Shola art sent by air and sea through tie-ups with foreign postal services.

queue.t: New on the map: India Post (Department of Posts)
queue.m: India's government-run postal operator, which delivers parcels through a network of about 1.64 lakh post offices and has signed last-mile delivery agreements with private logistics and e-commerce companies.

queue.t: New on the map: Blue Dart Express Limited
queue.m: Blue Dart is an Indian express air and ground courier and parcel carrier. It is majority-owned by DHL through DHL Express (Singapore) Pte. Ltd. and signed an agreement on 9 October 2026 to use India Post's network for parcel delivery.

queue.t: New on the map: Coll-8 Logistics
queue.m: Irish customs clearance and e-commerce logistics specialist that runs a digital customs clearance platform and the drop2shop pickup and drop-off network of more than 500 locations in the Republic of Ireland for deliveries and returns, and was acquired by Evri in 2025.

Belarus's largest online hypermarket, operated by Triovist, which received a postal licence in June 2026 and launched its own parcel delivery service, 21vek.by POST, with branches in Minsk and nearby suburbs.

queue.t: New on the map: Belposhta (RUE Belpochta)
queue.m: Belposhta is the state-owned national postal operator of Belarus. It handles domestic and international mail, parcels, EMS express and courier delivery.

queue.t: New on the map: DHL Supply Chain
queue.m: DHL Supply Chain is DHL Group's contract logistics division. It provides warehousing, transport, e-commerce fulfillment and returns management, and describes itself as the world's leading contract logistics provider.
